targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1057b (diagnostic, PASS, final_pass_dose_response_opposite_sign_across_orders_last_writer_signature): non_contributory for MECH-017, by design and correctly so. This run is fan-out probe 1 of the GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio registered by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1057-1057a-cluster_2026-09-20, whose declared null was 'both curves flat in k'. That null is REJECTED: all 4 legs (2 orders x {early, late}) are non-flat against FLAT_BAND=0.10 with per-leg sign consistency of 5 of 5 seeds (a leg-level maximum across rungs, not an endpoint-only count) -- mean relative delta k=0->k=24 of D1_early +1.3770, D1_late -0.3141, D2_early -0.4933, D2_late +0.4470. H-schedule is favoured in its strongest form; H-reallocation and H-intrinsic are recorded NOT SEPARATED, because order is perfectly confounded with which window is dosed and no arm breaks that confound. THREE QUALIFICATIONS THE MANIFEST DOES NOT MAKE. (1) C1's two halves differ in strength. The EARLY legs were close to forced -- at k=0 the dosed pass is skipped, so each order's reference rung sits in its MIRROR's last-writer state and the final pass carries ~102%/77% of the between-order early gap. The LATE legs were genuine tests: under an equal-four-point null they would read -0.069 and +0.102, both inside the 0.10 band, and they came in at -0.3141 and +0.4470. The driver is explicit about this in advance (:550-563: 'under the last-writer reading the two curves MUST move in OPPOSITE directions', with all four legs reconstructed non-flat from 1057a's rows before the run). (2) The four legs form a clean 2x2 sign flip -- each order ALSO inverts between its early and late strata, not only across orders -- yet _classify (driver lines 2375-2387) compares D1 against D2 within a stratum only, so the within-order inversion is computed nowhere. That within-order early/late trade-off is the zero-sum structure a reallocation account predicts, and it is unextracted evidence bearing on the very separation the run records as not made. (3) D2_late is the marginal leg: sign-consistent on 4 of 5 seeds at the endpoint (seed 456 at +0.0799, inside the band) and non-flat only at rungs 12 and 24. A SECOND REASON THE DIRECTION IS non_contributory, which the manifest does not state: the run does not satisfy MECH-017's non-degeneracy precondition (iii) AS IT STOOD AT RUN TIME -- 'the consolidation pass must actually UPDATE the world model (updates_<module> > 0 for the E1 and E2-world losses)'. The E1 half is met; the E2-world half is not, because the world-forward lever was left off and OFF is structural absence of the module key. SEPARATELY, the run's declared substrate limit 1 is factually incorrect: Agent.compute_e2_world_loss exists (ree_core/agent.py:12515) and is wired at ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py:766-778 behind default-off use_sleep_world_forward_consolidation, so MECH-017's co-primary world_forward readout is buildable-on-demand, not structurally unavailable. This is dated, not inferred: the trainer commit 4610133 (2026-09-17T20:53:57Z) is an ANCESTOR of the run's own substrate commit 995ba252 (2026-09-20T15:11:58Z), and the substrate_queue entry had already flipped to implemented_pending_validation at 2026-09-20T12:19:24Z -- about 3.5 hours before the run and before the driver was written. Leaving the lever off in THIS run was still correct (enabling it would have broken the bit-identical reproduction of the 1048/1057/1057a cells), but the declaration was stale at the moment it was made. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1057b_2026-09-22.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.note: REVERSED after the Step 7c red-team (CONTESTED, finding F1) and an EXECUTED confirmer. The first draft proposed `create` for a per-step data-window argument to consolidate(), on the premise that driver-side alternation would cold-start Adam every step. THAT PREMISE IS FALSE. consolidate() builds its per-module optimisers ONCE per call (cross_module_consolidation.py:158-162) and then calls the driver's own loss closure fresh on each of `steps` iterations (:164-183, driven by the interleaved loop at :185-195). A STATEFUL closure that alternates its window per call therefore interleaves whole-buffer and recent-window steps INSIDE ONE consolidate() call with Adam momentum intact. Confirmed by execution: 6 alternating steps, ONE Adam optimiser constructed, updates_e1 = 6. The fresh-Adam-per-CALL fact is real but irrelevant, because the interleaving never crosses a call boundary. No substrate work is owed.

re_derive_brake.note: MECH-017 ceiling count 0 under R1-R3 (5 targets tag the claim, none reads substrate_ceiling). This run is not a re-letter of the blocked construction -- it is the pre-registered fan-out probe the 1057/1057a cluster routed to, and it delivered.

learning_extracted: Ask whether a rejected null was reachable. C1's k=0 reference sits in the mirror order's last-writer state, a contrast already measured at ~13x FLAT_BAND before the run; rejecting 'flat in k' was therefore close to guaranteed. The reading survives, but 4/4 legs non-flat is a weaker surprise than the count suggests.

A 2x2 design carries two inversions and the classifier read only one. Each order inverts between its early and late strata as well as across orders; _classify compares within a stratum only, so the within-order trade-off -- the zero-sum signature a reallocation account predicts -- was measured and never computed.

A declared substrate limit is a claim about code and ages like one. 'E2.world_forward has no trainer in ree_core' was quoted faithfully from a substrate_queue entry that had since been implemented behind a default-off lever; the run's decision was still right, its stated reason was not.
Default-off is not absent, and the distinction changes routing: a co-primary readout behind a lever is complicated (buildable), not blocked.

Deviating from a claim's registered non-degeneracy precondition can be the stronger design. Routing through force_cycle would have exposed the buffer narrowing to every other reader in the cycle; isolating content and letting V3-EXQ-1026 own the wiring is a division of labour -- but it does mean this run can never discharge the confirming clause, which is a second, independent reason its direction is non_contributory.
